method: Cubic Hermite through retained full Galp vertices and mapped approach/exit vertices, plus the FIA 2021 direct T1–T2 connector 157736307. Endpoint tangents match the unchanged road outside the 4510–330 m wrap and 1160–1500 m interval. Resample at approximately 1 m, then evaluate the native 32-sample float32 Catmull rule before deriving one uniform geographic scale.
